title: Chatrapathi
desc: Sivaji and his family are uprooted from their Sri Lankan community and wind up as bonded labourers in Visakhapatnam. However, he rises to become a saviour of the oppressed, like his heroic namesake.

title: Gopi Kishan
desc: Policeman Gopi's doppelganger Kishan, who is a criminal, learns about the former and uses his identity to his advantage as he tries to find his father. This results in Gopi reaping the benefits.

title: Devi
desc: Devi, a snake goddess, vows to protect the daughter of the man who died while trying to save her from a powerful demon. However, she falls in love with a human, unaware of the consequences.

title: The Don
desc: A mysterious person vigilantly protects Vijay and his mother from notorious goons. His reasons for protecting them remain an unresolved enigma.

title: Baaghi
desc: Determined to rescue his former love, the ruggedly handsome Ronny confronts his enemies with a flurry of powerful roundhouse kicks and bone-crushing punches.
